posts.en:
dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-mcp-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MCP server manager: side-panel with per-status server listing, stdio/streamable-http setup forms, mcpServers JSON import, exponential-backoff reconnect, and tools registered to the model as mcp__<server>__<tool>.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0783cb9b63c14e85225b.html
